display.purpose: Page headers and hero text. Responsive: 40px on desktop, 32px on mobile.

headline.purpose: Card headings, major section titles. Strong weight signals hierarchy.

body.purpose: Primary content and paragraph text. Capped at 65–75 characters per line.

label.purpose: Form labels, secondary content, button text. Medium weight for emphasis.

caption.purpose: Footnotes, helper text, metadata. Smallest readable size.

shadows.name: nav-float
shadows.purpose: Floating bottom navigation only. Indicates above-content elevation.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: State transitions on buttons, inputs, and interactive elements.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: Below this, display font scales down to 32px.

breakpoints.name: shell-max
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of the mobile shell container.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: High-confidence action (save, generate, submit). Golden primary background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #ffb81c; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Button Secondary
components.description: Lower-priority action. Neutral surface background, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; background: #f5f3ef; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ede9e1; border-color: #dcd8d0; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #e8e4dc; }

components.name: Button Pill Active
components.description: Tab-like selection. Active state uses primary gold background.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { background: #f5f3ef; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-pill-active { background: #ffb81c; color: #ffffff; border-color: transparent; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Input Text
components.description: Text input field for recipe names, ingredient search, quantities.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #f5f3ef; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 13px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e6b65; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #111111; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.1); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Container for recipe, meal plan, or shopping item. Warm surface color, subtle border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f5f3ef; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0; color: #6e6b65; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Pill Tag
components.description: Inline metadata, category, or state label.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: #f5f3ef; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 10px; color: #6e6b65; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Fixed floating nav at bottom of mobile shell. Tab-based navigation between Recipes, Planner, Shopping.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: 16px; width: min(calc(100vw - 36px), 424px); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8e4dc; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); z-index: 20; } .ds-bottom-nav button { background: transparent; border: 0; color: #6e6b65; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-bottom-nav button:hover { color: #111111; } .ds-bottom-nav button.active { color: #ffb81c; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: appCompras is a warm, inviting meal-planning tool built on a culinary foundation. The color palette—golden amber primary with vibrant accent colors—evokes both the practical efficiency of a kitchen and the diversity of ingredients. The design is intentionally minimal and calm: breathing room, generous whitespace, two complementary typefaces, and minimal shadows. Users plan meals without stress or corporate coldness. This is not a spreadsheet. It's a capable, thoughtful companion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, approachable neutrals with one strong golden primary accent
Two-font hierarchy: serif-leaning display type, clean sans body
Minimal elevation (flat by default, single soft shadow on fixed nav)
Mobile-first responsive; generous tap targets (44px minimum)
Breathing space between sections; varied rhythm in padding and margins

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The golden primary (#ffb81c) is used on ≤10% of any screen. It is never combined with other accent colors on a single screen.

rules.name: The Warm Foundation Rule
rules.body: Every neutral should tint slightly toward the palette's warm hue, never pure gray. Warmth invites; cool grays make the interface feel sterile.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is achieved through weight (400 → 600) and size (16px → 40px), never through color alone.

rules.name: The Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Body text is capped at 65–75 characters per line. On wider screens, add constraints so reading remains comfortable.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows are forbidden except on the fixed bottom navigation. Use tonal layering and borders to define structure.

dos: Do use the golden primary (#ffb81c) for the single most important action on any screen. ≤10% coverage.
Do rely on tonal layering (surface colors) and 1px borders to define structure. No shadows except the bottom nav.
Do maintain 44px minimum tap target size on mobile for all interactive elements.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — no automatic animations, state changes only.
Do ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for body text).
Do use Bricolage Grotesque sparingly (h1, card headings). Weight contrast with Inter is the visual rhythm.
Do cap body text at 65–75 characters per line and use left-align.
donts: Don't combine multiple accent colors on a single screen.
Don't use #000000 or #ffffff as pure black/white. Tint toward warmth.
Don't add shadows to cards, buttons, or inputs. Only the nav floats.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as a colored accent.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Transitions only on background-color, opacity, color.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text) for emphasis.
Don't use glassmorphism, blur effects, or decorative overlays.
Don't assume dark mode is an improvement. The warm, light palette is the complete vision.
Don't use SaaS marketing clichés: no gradient backgrounds, no neon accents, no AI-hype language.
